# Britannica Curiosity Compass

> > An interactive personality assessment platform that identifies individual curiosity types and learning styles through the lens of historical figures like Marie Curie, Malala Yousafzai, and Grace Hopper.

Britannica's Curiosity Compass helps users discover their unique approach to learning and exploration by connecting them with iconic scientists, explorers, and inventors. The platform combines personality assessment with educational content about Nobel Prize winners, STEM pioneers, and world-changing innovators.

## Key Topics

- Curiosity Types
- Learning Styles
- Personality Assessment
- Marie Curie

## Curiosity Assessment

- [Britannica's Curiosity Compass](https://curiosity.britannica.com/): Interactive quiz platform exploring curiosity types and learning styles

## Curiosity Personality Profiles

- [Scientist Personality Profile](https://curiosity.britannica.com/scientist): Scientist personality profile featuring Marie Curie & discovery methods
- [Explorer Personality Profile](https://curiosity.britannica.com/explorer): Explorer personality profile featuring Malala Yousafzai & experiential learning
- [Inventor Personality Profile](https://curiosity.britannica.com/inventor): Inventor personality profile featuring Grace Hopper & creative innovation
